title: malus trilobata
intro: Malus trilobata, commonly known as the Three-lobed Crab Apple or Devil's Darning Needle, is a deciduous shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Malus trilobata include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and treat skin conditions, among other uses. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
